definition: the line where one country meets another
description: A selfie video on a road bridge on a bright winter day. A young man in a black beanie with a rucksack holds a small passport in one hand and grins at the camera; behind him two flags snap on poles and a queue of cars waits at a lifted red and white boom bar. He walks on along the footway past a glass control booth, and a broad painted stripe in blue, white and red runs across the road surface beneath his feet. He looks down at the painted stripe, steps over it, and walks on with the river and the far bank in view.

de.answer: Er überquert die Grenze zu Fuß.
